items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So an Attorney, John Glespin approached me and signed me up with Columbia Artists.

ctx.x: A five year contract. But, things began happening so fast, and as I said before, Claude couldn't do anything. He had gone as far as he could go. So an Attorney, John Glespin approached me and signed me up with Columbia Artists. And of course they knew what my situation was with Claude and Gladys, and so they relinquished part of their commission which they were to receive to be held in escrow in lieu of a settlement with Gladys and Claude. And so for the next five years a certain amount of mine, in fact, when I…
Can I ask approximately how large a salary would be in those days?
